Manual vs Automatic Mode
  • Manual mode: operator confirms every reading by hand.
  • Automatic mode: system estimates and flags exceptions only.
Feature Highlights
  • Highlight one: tolerance thresholds are configurable per meter.
  • Highlight two: lockouts trigger after repeated failures.
  • Highlight three: uptime targets are tracked per polling service.
